raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "work at"
  role subject "Kenji"
  role object "the Nagoya branch of Tanaka Precision"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "work at"
  role subject "Hiroshi"
  role object "the Nagoya branch of Tanaka Precision"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "work at"
  role subject "Yumi"
  role object "the Nagoya branch of Tanaka Precision"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "teach evening classes at"
  role subject "Yumi"
  role object "the university"
  role location "Nagoya"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "teach"
    role subject ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end
  compare any
  ?x equal "Kenji"
  ?x equal "Hiroshi"
  ?x equal "Yumi"
  end
